title: Application Services, API Clients & DTOs
objectives: Build a typed API client layer
Map DTOs to domain models at the edge
Inject services instead of importing singletons everywhere

examples.name: api.ts

exercise.prompt: Order the request pipeline: "map DTO to domain", "fetch + parse JSON", "component renders", "service called by composable".
hints: Transport happens first; mapping turns wire shapes into domain types.
Components only ever see mapped, typed data.

questions.prompt: Where do snake_case → camelCase conversions belong?
questions.explanation: Wire-format concerns are transport concerns; map once at the edge.

questions.prompt: Injecting an api client (vs importing a singleton) mainly buys…
options: testability — tests can substitute a fake
questions.explanation: Injected dependencies can be replaced per test; hardcoded singletons cannot.
